scope.plan_status_at_review: Final plan not yet present; the proposed contract and source semantics were reviewed. Root will freeze the plan before execution.

existing_independent_qualification.scope: Finite public physical/Jacobian fixtures only; no saved Cell B vectors, estimator or primary diagnostic protocols.

prior_contract_clarifications.conditioning: Each protocol independently starts from a saved current-state vector. Varying a parameter holds entering z, v1-v3 and h fixed and excludes its pre-anchor history effect. These are future open-loop response sensitivities, not retrospective identification or estimator adaptation.
prior_contract_clarifications.normalization: The first eleven physical parameters use an infinitesimal 1% fractional differential. Log coordinates use native increment 0.01; linear positive coordinates use 0.01 times that anchor value. This is explicitly not an exact finite +1% perturbation. Current SOC uses 0.01 fraction, RC states 0.001 V and h 0.01.
prior_contract_clarifications.strict_positive_premise: The frozen plan requires all eleven physical parameter anchors to be strictly positive. Zero-relative normalization is outside this analysis contract; no artificial floor is introduced.
prior_contract_clarifications.SOC_proxy: Actual propagated SOC differences remain separate from the voltage divided by local OCV slope proxy. The latter is not a physical SOC error, bound, estimator response or coverage statement.
prior_contract_clarifications.interactions: Compute signed per-time effects and sums before peak/RMS reduction; distinguish exact isolated effects, full joint effects, cross-coordinate interaction and first-order residual.
prior_contract_clarifications.grid: Exactly 35 Hz end-of-interval observations, plus t=0 under the first current. Instantaneous switch outputs after t=0 are omitted. Peak means a maximum on this declared grid.
prior_contract_clarifications.domain: Invalid or nonfinite paths stop with an exception; no clipping or adaptive protocol shortening. A failed analysis is not promised an exact first-invalid index.
prior_contract_clarifications.capacity: No capacity acquisition deadline is added. These physical propagation protocols do not run or qualify continued estimator learning.

source_review.derivative_shapes: Trajectory arrays use T+1 samples, voltage/SOC Jacobians (T+1,16), and carried RC derivatives (3,16). Broadcasting and column-wise multiplication by native coordinate error have the intended shapes.
source_review.propagation: Closed-form constant-current dwells carry entering physical states and derivatives into the next dwell. Direct log-tau, resistance, active log-gamma and log-capacity terms agree with the reviewed production equations. Previously acquired sensitivity to the other gamma is retained through the carried h derivative.
source_review.parameter_units: Logs map to seconds, inverse Ah and Ah; linear resistance, H and entering RC states remain ohm or volt as labeled. Multiplication by 1000 yields mV and by 100 yields SOC percentage points.
source_review.normalization_at_each_anchor: unit_scales(truth) and unit_scales(estimate) are intentionally separate. Their comparison changes both the derivative and the physical size of a 1% unit for linear parameters; report this when comparing the two sensitivities.
source_review.exact_known_error_paths: An isolated injection replaces one truth coordinate with its estimated coordinate. A conditional repair replaces one estimated coordinate with truth. All other coordinates and the common protocol remain fixed. These are not refits or uniquely attributable causes of estimation bias.
source_review.error_orientation: All full and isolated errors use estimated/injected minus truth. Both truth- and estimate-anchor linearizations multiply by estimate-minus-truth in the native chart, consistently approximating that error orientation.
source_review.repair_orientation: one_coordinate_repair_effect_mV is original estimated voltage minus repaired voltage. It represents the removed signed prediction contribution; the signed change after applying the repair has the opposite sign. A positive repair effect does not alone establish reduced absolute error.
source_review.OCV_proxy: The source divides each signed voltage-error sample by the truth-baseline OCV slope at that sample before taking metrics. It does not divide a peak by a separate peak slope. The illustrative curve has positive slope on the valid domain.
source_review.RMS_and_peak: RMS uses all end-of-interval samples and excludes t=0. Peak, signed-at-peak, initial and final values include t=0 where applicable. Fixed dt makes the RMS a uniform time-grid measure.
source_review.joint_interaction: nonlinear_interaction is full joint voltage error minus the signed sum of exact isolated errors. joint_linearization_residual is full error minus the signed sum of truth Jacobian contributions. These distinct residuals correctly separate cross-coordinate interaction from total first-order error.
source_review.cancellation_ratio: joint_RMS_over_sum_absolute_isolated_RMS uses the RMS of the pointwise sum of absolute isolated effects. It is not a bounded cancellation fraction, an error bound or a sum of individual RMS values; nonlinear interaction can affect its magnitude.
source_review.profiles: All 35 Hz samples enter metrics. Reduced plot profiles retain only the final anchor and do not determine the numerical summaries.
source_review.provenance_and_execution: Execution verifies committed source bytes, saved-evidence hash and qualified-source hashes, refuses an existing output directory, and preserves a started receipt before computing protocols. No estimator or optimizer is called.
source_review.application_limits: Propagation of the saved aggregate mean is a deterministic point diagnostic. It is not predictive mixture integration, posterior covariance propagation, observability, coverage, hard support or a pruning criterion.

nonblocking_output_limit.item: soc_jacobian is computed and independently qualified, but execute exports exact isolated/joint SOC-error effects rather than normalized SOC derivative metrics.
nonblocking_output_limit.report_resolution: State the analytic relation z(t)=z_anchor-C_Ah(t)/Q, dz/dlogQ=C_Ah(t)/Q and dz/dz_anchor=1. The other fourteen coordinates have zero actual SOC derivatives under this conditioning. Do not claim the output file contains normalized SOC derivative tables.

report_requirements: Keep results separate by anchor and protocol; there is no unique protocol-independent parameter ranking.
Separate normalized sensitivity from response to the actual saved error.
State repair orientation and the unbounded diagnostic meaning of the cancellation ratio.
Use the 1 mV noise level only as a per-sample reference, never as an identifiability or parameter-importance threshold.
Treat simulated currents as model-analysis protocols rather than hardware operating recommendations.
Preserve original inference, truth isolation and the capacity no-deadline amendment.
stop: Review complete. Freeze the declared plan, run only the predetermined offline analysis, preserve its first result, then stop at interpretation without tuning or estimator reruns.
